macros.name: sankeyadvance
macros.doc: The \sankeyadvance moves the sankey node straight ahead and fills/draws this portion of the sankey path.

macros.name: sankeyfork
macros.doc: The \sankeyfork macro splits the preexisting Sankey node named ⟨name⟩ in a list of new Sankey subnodes.

macros.name: sankeygetnodeorient
macros.doc: The expandable command \sankeygetnodeorient returns the angle (orientation) assigned to the Sankey node named ⟨node name⟩.

macros.name: sankeygetnodeqty
macros.doc: The expandable command \sankeygetnodeqty returns the quantity assigned to the Sankey node named ⟨node name⟩.

macros.name: sankeynode
macros.doc: The \sankeynode macro defines a Sankey node.

macros.name: sankeynodealias
macros.doc: The \sankeynodealias macro clones the Sankey node named ⟨origname⟩ into the Sankey node named ⟨clonename⟩.

macros.name: sankeyoutin
macros.doc: The \sankeyoutin macro fills/draws a lane from ⟨node A⟩ to ⟨node B⟩ using a Bézier curve with regular steps (10 steps by default) to simulate constant width lane.

macros.name: sankeyqtytolen
macros.doc: The expandable \sankeyqtytolen macro converts ⟨quantity⟩ to graphical length using the current ratio.

macros.name: sankeyset
macros.doc: The \sankeyset macro processes its parameter as a list of comma separated pairs of the form key=value with /sankey as default path.

macros.name: sankeyturn
macros.doc: The \sankeyturn macro moves the sankey node by turning to one side or the other and fills/draws this portion of the sankey path.

macros.name: sankeyturnleft
macros.doc: The \sankeyturnleft macro moves the sankey node by turning left and fills/draws this portion of the sankey path.

macros.name: sankeyturnleftbackward
macros.doc: The \sankeyturnleftbackward macro moves the sankey node backward by turning left and fills/draws this portion of the sankey path.

macros.name: sankeyturnright
macros.doc: The \sankeyturnright macro moves the sankey node by turning right and fills/draws this portion of the sankey path.

macros.name: sankeyturnrightbackward
macros.doc: The \sankeyturnrightbackward macro moves the sankey node backward by turning right and fills/draws this portion of the sankey path.
